highlights: Ugreen 35740 Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo
Ugreen MK006 (35740) Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo is an easy and reliable way to extend your office and home computing setup.

This combo operates over a 2.4 GHz wireless frequency with a USB receiver for easy plug-and-play functionality, freeing you from annoying wires and maintaining a neat working environment. It has a very stable connection and operates within a 10-meter (33 ft.) area without losing connectivity.

The 106 full-sized keys are present in the keyboard design for complete and comfortable typing. At the top of the keyboard, there are 13 different shortcuts for quick access to important multimedia functions, independent indicator lights for clarity, and an intelligent sleep mode to save power.
The thin and silent chocolate keycaps enable a smooth typing experience, while the ergonomic arc design and adjustable tilt angle reduces wrist strain during extended use.

The ergonomic mouse is designed for comfort and functionality. It is quiet to operate, making it perfect for work or leisure that does not have interruptions. With the high-precision 4000 DPI sensor and five adjustable DPI levels, it can ensure accurate and smooth tracking on different surfaces.
This wireless keyboard and mouse combo works with various operating systems, including Windows XP/Vista/7/8/10, Mac, and so on. It applies to laptops, desktops, tablets, smart TVs, and other devices.
Note that the required AA battery is not included. Ugreen MK006-35740 is efficient, practical, and useful in enhancing your productivity by providing more comfort.
Ideal for work, study, or casual use, this combo meets your daily demands with ease.
